On the sidelines of the Meeting, Dr. Kao is scheduled to engage in a number of bilateral meetings to discuss and exchange views on matters of common interest and concern, as well as to find ways in advancing the ASEAN-EU Dialogue Partnership.

The 14th Meeting of the ASEAN-New Zealand Joint Cooperation Committee (ANZJCC), held today at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, reaffirmed both sides’ commitment to further deepening cooperation under the ASEAN-New Zealand Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP). The Meeting was co-chaired by H.E. Ambassador Dr. Ton Thi Ngoc Huong, Permanent Representative of Viet Nam to ASEAN, and H.E. Joanna Anderson, Ambassador of New Zealand to ASEAN, and was attended by the Permanent Representatives of ASEAN Member States or their representatives, as well as representatives of the ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting took note of the completion of implementation of the ASEAN-New Zealand Plan of Action (POA) (2021–2025) and the progress achieved thus far in implementing the ASEAN-New Zealand POA (2026–2030), which commenced in January 2026. Building on the momentum of the 50th anniversary of ASEAN-New Zealand Dialogue Relations in 2025, both sides looked forward to advancing cooperation under the CSP including through the implementation of the POA (2026–2030).

Sensitive Price Indicator of 51 essential items in Pakistan for week ended April 23, 2026 rose 13.98% YoY—a broad-based cost shock, not a narrow spike. Electricity (+54%), LPG (+51%), Petrol (+44%), Diesel (+37%) are leading the surge, spilling over into essentials: wheat flour (+36%), onions (+32%), tomatoes (+23%), meat and milk also rising. Some relief in potatoes (-47%), pulses, sugar and tea—but not enough to offset energy-led inflation. Bottom line: Cost-push inflation—energy first, food next, households under strain, with Middle East tensions adding upside risk to fuel prices.

Switzerland has made it illegal to place live lobsters into boiling water, following increasing scientific evidence that crustaceans may be sentient, capable of experiencing pain. Over recent decades, research has challenged the idea that lobsters operate on simple reflexes alone. Studies suggest their nervous systems are more complex, showing behaviors that go beyond automatic reactions and point toward decision-making under distress. For example, experiments with related species like hermit crabs have shown they will abandon their shells, essential for protection, when exposed to electric shocks. This kind of trade-off suggests an ability to weigh risk in order to avoid harm. Lobsters themselves possess nociceptors, specialized nerve cells that detect damaging stimuli such as heat. When exposed to extreme conditions, they don’t just react momentarily; they can exhibit prolonged behavioral changes, indicating a deeper response. Under the new law, lobsters must be stunned before being cooked, either mechanically or electrically, to reduce suffering. The legislation also bans transporting lobsters on ice, requiring conditions that more closely reflect their natural environment. Supporters view this as a necessary step forward. Many scientists argue that if there is credible evidence an animal can feel pain, it deserves consideration similar to that given to birds and mammals. But this raises a bigger question. With billions of crustaceans used globally each year, and practices varying widely—should other countries begin to rethink how these animals are treated? Source: CNN, “Switzerland bans boiling lobsters alive.”

Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri and Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council, MQI, visited Minhaj Cultural Center Kløfta. Members and designators are gathered to warmly welcome them. During the visit, the distinguished guests were given a guided tour of Minhaj Cultural Center Kløfta, and office bearers and contributors in Kløfta had the opportunity to introduce themselves to Shaykh-ul-Islam. Shaykh-ul-Islam offered guidance on the upbringing of children and emphasized the importance of the active role of parents. He pointed out that many children today are largely shaped by three central factors: social media, school, and society. It was further highlighted that the home has increasingly been reduced to merely a place for overnight stay, as parents are often occupied with work and participate less in the upbringing of their children, leaving this responsibility largely to these three influencing factors. In conclusion, Shaykh-ul-Islam made dua for Minhaj Cultural Center Kløfta, praying for increased progress and blessings for the center, as well as for all those who contribute to building and strengthening it as an important institution in society, and for everyone who participates in its activities. The visit was hosted by Minhaj Cultural Center Kløfta, including Asif Javed (President), Rizwan ul Haq (General Secretary), Imran Aslam (Vice President), Kamran Zaman (Vice President), Tanseer Malik (Welfare), Zameer Butt (Building Coordinator), Safdar Ali (Imam), and Nasir Ali Awan (Imam). Kløfta also received a visit from the national leadership, including Awais Ejaz Ahmed Warraich (President), Hassan Bashir (General Secretary), Zartash Bashir (Vice President), Ata-ul-Mustafa Mahmood (Deputy Secretary), and Atif Rauf (Finance Secretary). Other participants included Ameer-e-Tehreek Afzal Ansari, Chaudhry Mushtaq (Rabita Committee), Allama Iqbal Fani (Director, Minhaj-ul-Quran International Norway), Allama Sadaqat Ali (Principal, Minhaj School), Dr. Nazia Batool, and Ibrahim Malik (Marketing and Finance, Minhaj Youth). Several representatives from Ullensaker Muslimske Senter also participated, including the imam and other contributors. Strategic Synergy: Driving the Future of India-Japan Economic Cooperation NITI Aayog hosted Mr. Masahiko Yokohama, Chief Executive Officer, Sumitomo Corporation Global Research (SCGR), for a high-level interaction on strengthening India–Japan economic cooperation. The meeting was led by Shri Sanjeet Singh, Programme Director, NITI Aayog, along with senior officials. The discussions focused on key pillars of collaboration, including sustainable infrastructure through a structured private-sector model, with an emphasis on “building right the first time” to position India as a global blueprint for developing regions. Deliberations on the green transition explored Green Hydrogen and nuclear energy to support AI-driven data centres while advancing Net Zero targets. The role of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), particularly the JAM Trinity (Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, Mobile), in enabling financial inclusion and collateral-free credit was highlighted. The importance of inclusive growth through scaling initiatives such as the Aspirational Districts Programme, using data-driven governance to address poverty at the grassroots, was also underscored. The interaction reflected a shared commitment to channelling long-term capital into projects that will define the next century of global progress. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #StrategicPartnership #SustainableInfrastructure #GreenTransition #DPI #ViksitBharat

इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय कला केंद्र, कलानिधि प्रभाग द्वारा आयोजित संगोष्ठी “Indian Manuscripts: Knowledge Systems, Cultural Memory, and Contemporary Relevance” ने भारत की समृद्ध ज्ञान परंपरा को एक नए दृष्टिकोण से प्रस्तुत किया। केंद्र के सदस्य सचिव Dr. Sachchidanand Joshi ने अपने उद्बोधन में कहा कि भारत विश्व की सबसे समृद्ध पांडुलिपि परंपराओं का धनी है—जहाँ ज्ञान केवल भाषा या लिपि तक सीमित नहीं, बल्कि व्यापक सांस्कृतिक विरासत का हिस्सा है। ‘ज्ञान भारतम्’ मिशन के अंतर्गत चल रहा राष्ट्रीय पांडुलिपि सर्वेक्षण, जिओ-टैगिंग और दस्तावेजीकरण इस दिशा में एक ऐतिहासिक पहल है। इस संगोष्ठी में वेद, दर्शन, इतिहास, कला, साहित्य, विज्ञान, योग और आयुर्वेद जैसे विविध विषयों पर गहन चर्चा हुई, जिसमें विद्वानों ने पांडुलिपियों को भारत की सांस्कृतिक स्मृति और ज्ञान के जीवंत स्रोत के रूप में रेखांकित किया। कलानिधि प्रभाग के विभागाध्यक्ष एवं डीन प्रो. (डॉ) @gaurrc ने पावर प्वाइंट प्रेजेंटेशन के माध्यम से पांडुलिपियों के बारे में विस्तार से जानकारी दी। इसके अलावा उन्होंने केंद्र की इस अभियान में भूमिका के बारे में भी बताया। यह आयोजन न केवल अतीत की विरासत को समझने का माध्यम बना, बल्कि वर्तमान और भविष्य के लिए ज्ञान संरक्षण, अध्ययन और प्रसार की दिशा में एक सार्थक संवाद भी स्थापित करता है। #IGNCA #GyanBharatam #IndianManuscripts #KnowledgeTradition #CulturalHeritage @MinOfCultureGoI @Gyan_Bharatam @PMOIndia @narendramodi @DDNational @gssjodhpur

पंचायती राज, महात्मा गांधी के ग्राम स्वराज के सपने को साकार करने की दिशा में एक मजबूत नींव रही है। पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री राजीव गांधी जी ने भारत के गांवों को सशक्त बनाते हुए उन्हें देश की मुख्य धारा से जोड़ा। उन्होंने हर वर्ग को अधिकार दिलाए और पंचायती राज व्यवस्था के माध्यम से जनभागीदारी को सुनिश्चित किया। पंचायती राज महिला सशक्तिकरण का भी एक महत्वपूर्ण माध्यम रहा है। 1993 से 73वें संविधान संशोधन के माध्यम से पंचायती राज संस्थाओं में महिलाओं के लिए कम से कम 33% आरक्षण सुनिश्चित किया गया। आज कई राज्यों में यह बढ़ाकर 50% तक कर दिया गया है। कांग्रेस की इस ऐतिहासिक पहल का परिणाम है कि आज देशभर में लगभग 14 से 15 लाख से अधिक निर्वाचित महिला प्रतिनिधि पंचायती राज संस्थाओं में सक्रिय भूमिका निभा रही हैं - जो दुनिया में महिलाओं की सबसे बड़ी लोकतांत्रिक भागीदारी में से एक है। पंचायती राज व्यवस्था ने देश की महिलाओं को नेतृत्व करने और राजनीति में अपनी भागीदारी सुनिश्चित करने का सुनहरा अवसर दिया है। देश के सभी मुखिया, पंचों और स्थानीय निकायों के सदस्यों को पंचायती राज दिवस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं।

Whatever happens with Russia’s ambitions, one thing is clear – Europe together with Ukraine will be able to defend itself. And I believe as a result of both our defense of Europe and our reforms, Ukraine should gain full membership in the EU. Thank you to everyone working to speed it up. It is important that already in May we can move to unblocking the clusters – to open the first cluster and immediately the rest of 5 clusters and then to start closing the chapters. We seek the same full membership that every EU nation has – from Cyprus to Poland. The only thing we ask is speeding up the full membership – with a clear start date for membership. This is necessary to prevent Russia from endlessly blocking our path – and not only blocking, but also dividing and weakening Europe to stop Ukraine. A clear timeline and a fast track can prevent this. That is why we are asking for it. We are ready to work together to make Ukraine’s membership happen. Thank you. Geoheritage identifies geologic features that shape our landscapes and our history, culture, and identity as a nation. These places help us understand Earth’s past and how it affects us today. From the columnar basalt formations of Devils Postpile National Monument to dunes shaped by wind and glacial sands at Indiana Dunes National Park, these sites show how geologic processes shape the land and how people study and use it. I thank every leader who understands how important it is for Ukraine to move toward EU membership. In this war, we defend not only ourselves, but also the European way of life. Whatever happens with Russia’s ambitions, one thing is clear – Europe together with Ukraine will be able to defend itself. And I believe as a result of both our defense of Europe and our reforms, Ukraine should gain full membership in the EU. Thank you to everyone working to speed it up. It is important that already in May we can move to unblocking the clusters – to open the first cluster and immediately the rest of 5 clusters and then to start closing the chapters. We seek the same full membership that every EU nation has – from Cyprus to Poland. The only thing we ask is speeding up the full membership – with a clear start date for membership. This is necessary to prevent Russia from endlessly blocking our path – and not only blocking, but also dividing and weakening Europe to stop Ukraine. A clear timeline and a fast track can prevent this. That is why we are asking for it. We are ready to work together to make Ukraine’s membership happen. Thank you. From an address at the European Council meeting (3/3).

Ukraine is now actively working with countries in the Middle East and the Gulf. We are preparing cooperation with the Caucasus and talking to other partners. And I want to stress – Ukraine offers not just drones, but a full defense system. For example, Arab states have strong air defense against missiles, and we help them set up protection against Shahed drones and at sea. This kind of integrated defense is what we need to build for Europe as well – to protect borders, coastlines, the sea, infrastructure, and everything that could be targeted. I believe this should be a truly European project. Of course, each country works for its own defense, but joint European efforts can have much greater impact. SAFE program – likely not enough, because each country does what it sees fit, and what it can do, while drone threats are new and evolving. We need to coordinate and create a common European tool – a program on drones. We are ready to invest our expertise, our facilities, and our capacity. From an address at the European Council meeting (2/3).

I thank all European leaders for the European support package for Ukraine and the 20th sanctions package against Russia. This will truly help. We really count on the 90 billion support package to deliver the first tranche – as soon as possible. This money is for our army, and we are ready to buy weapons with it – including air defense. It is also funding that will help us prepare for winter – and work has already started to protect our energy system, and the European funds will support this as well. And please continue your work on sanctions against Russia. It is right to strengthen sanctions, especially since the Americans have eased some of theirs. Right now, the situation on the front in Ukraine is special. Our positions are more stable than in previous months and years, and Russia is losing at least 30-35 thousand soldiers every month. It is difficult for Russia, and we should make it even harder for them – in order to push them to diplomacy. From an address at the European Council meeting (1/3).

Wars function as a system. What counts is not village Russia captures or Ukraine retakes, but continuous interaction across the battlefield, long-range strikes, infrastructure, and the wider regional environment. RedHorizon tracks these developments and places them into a wider context. The latest issue (15–21 APR 2026) highlights several ongoing dynamics: • Russian operations continue to prioritise steady pressure and degradation over rapid manoeuvre, particularly along the Donbas axis • The strategic strike campaign remains focused on energy infrastructure, shaping operational conditions beyond the frontline • Ukrainian deep strikes are generating cumulative effects on Russian logistics, air defence, and sustainment • The conflict is increasingly defined by competition between systems—energy, logistics, command, and industrial capacity • NATO’s eastern flank operates under persistent, low-level pressure, where escalation risk is driven more by exposure than intent Recent developments also point to growing internal pressure within Ukraine, with hybrid and kinetic activity increasingly targeting the domestic environment. RedHorizon is designed to track exactly this: not just events, but how different elements of the conflict interact over time. If you are interested in access, feel free to reach out.

African industrialists and entrepreneurs are key drivers of economic growth and innovation in various sectors, including manufacturing, industrialisation, banking and technology. As a result, they are crucial partners with governments in transforming our countries, especially in investment and employment creation. Met Mr @AlikoDangote, founder of the Dangote Group and Africa's leading industrialist with interests in cement and sugar manufacturing, and oil refining, on the sidelines of the Africa We Build Summit, Nairobi. We welcome his announcement at the summit that he was ready to partner with Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania in building an oil refinery in Tanga, Tanzania. We thank Mr Dangote for believing in Africa and are committed to working with him to make this very important regional project a reality.

Kenya and Africa Finance Corporation (AFC) are co-hosting the Africa We Build Summit in Nairobi because our governments and African financial institutions have a common goal of ending the age-old practice of exporting raw materials. Our minerals, agricultural products and all the other raw materials we export earn us a minute fraction of what value-added products are worth. In addition, our manufacturing has stagnated while tens of thousands of jobs are exported. At the same time, AFC has opened its first regional office in Nairobi and today we signed a Host Country Agreement with the financial institution. To support this great African institution, we will deepen our commitment with a $25 million share capital. Held talks with AFC President and CEO Samaila Zubairu on the sidelines of the Africa We Build Summit, Nairobi.

Kenya and the Africa Import-Export Bank (Afrieximbank) have a strong and cordial relationship boosted by a 2023 country programme to accelerate industrialisation, special economic zones, industrial parks and infrastructure. Consequently, we are working with the bank in the development of several special economic zones at Dongo Kundu (Mombasa), Sagana (Kirinyaga), Naivasha (Nakuru), Thika (Kiambu), Eldoret (Uasin Gishu), Nasewa (Busia) and, with Kenya Commercial Bank, Vipingo SEZ (Kilifi). We support AfriEximbank and other African financial institutions because they understand our countries better, have developed home-grown solutions to our challenges and they believe in Africa. This is the reason Kenya boosted our share capital in the bank by $50 million a few years ago. Met AfriEximbank President and Chairman of the Board of Directors George Elombi on the sidelines of the Africa We Build Summit, Nairobi.

I need to scream into the void of the internet. I don't expect any of you to give a shit. I just want to share an observation I've had. Since I've had a kid I've noticed some parents unironically ego others about their children. I'm not sure what it is, maybe it's some sort reflection of their personalities, but I think it's super fucking weird. Like, my son was an objectively large baby. He was born in the 100th percentile, meaning he is statistically larger than 100 percent of babies. This doesn't mean he's destined to be a freak athlete, it doesn't mean he's going to be walking giant, it means almost nothing because the cause of large babies is either the Mother is diabetic ... or it's genetics. In our case it was genetics. It's totally possible he will be large now and by the time he's 10 he will be BELOW average. The size of a baby at birth doesn't reflect anything about their future. When I tell someone my son was born large, I'll always have one person interject and say something akin to "MY SON WAS BIGGER" ... even though I know they're lying or exaggerating. Alternatively, I'll say something like, "I think my son is doing really good, he eats a lot". Suddenly some parent will be like "MY DAUGHTER EATS MORE. SHE EATS EVERYTHING". I've seen parents blatantly LIE about their children's abilities. I've had parents tell me their children began walking completely unassisted at 5 months old. That sort of development is virtually impossible. Babies at that age do not possess the coordination skills to walk yet. LITERALLY their BRAIN isn't physiologically PREPARED for movement of that sort yet. Early-early-EARLY walking babies is like, 7 months old. However, this is freakishly rare, it's an anomaly. I've seen parents exaggerate or lie about: - Height - Weight - Eating habits - Coordination - Intelligence - Learning speed - Academic skills - ??? It's a really, really, really weird one-up thing with their children. I have no idea why people do it. I've also noticed some parents AGGRESSIVELY try to shove their ideas down your throat and assert THEY ARE right and YOU are wrong about literally anything. It's the weirdest shit bro. I get it, you love your children and you're proud of them, but they turn it into a competition. God damn

وفي ختام الاجتماع تم التوقيع على اتفاقية بين حكومة المملكة العربية السعودية والمجلس الفيدرالي السويسري في شأن التشجيع والحماية المتبادلة للاستثمارات، وقعها من الجانب السعودي معالي وزير الاستثمار المهندس فهد السيف، ومن الجانب السويسري فخامة رئيس الاتحاد السويسري السيد غي بارملان، والتي تهدف إلى تعزيز واستقرار البيئة استثمارية، وحماية حقوق المستثمرين، ودعم تدفق الاستثمارات المتبادلة بين البلدين.

ويأتي هذا الاجتماع على هامش الزيارة الرسمية لفخامة رئيس الاتحاد السويسري للمملكة، وفي ظل احتفاء البلدين على مرور (٧٠) عاماً من العلاقات الدبلوماسية، والتي أسهمت منذ البداية في ترسيخ أسس التعاون وبناء شراكة قائمة على الاحترام المتبادل وتطوير المصالح المشتركة بين البلدين الصديقين.

মালয়েশিয়া সফর শেষে দেশে প্রত্যাবর্তন করলেন সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান ঢাকা, ২৩ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): গত ২২ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ তারিখে মালয়েশিয়া সফর শেষে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জেনারেল ওয়াকার-উজ-জামান, এসবিপি, ওএসপি, এসজিপি, পিএসসি দেশে প্রত্যাবর্তন করেন। গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী ও প্রতিরক্ষামন্ত্রী জনাব তারেক রহমান, এমপি, এর প্রতিনিধি হিসেবে সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান মালয়েশিয়ার কুয়ালালামপুরে অনুষ্ঠিত The Defence Services Asia (DSA) ও National Security Asia (NATSEC ASIA) 2026 Exhibition এ অংশগ্রহণ করে বিভিন্ন দেশের আধুনিক প্রতিরক্ষা ব্যবস্থা, ইলেকট্রনিক যুদ্ধ প্রযুক্তি, নিরাপত্তা ও যুদ্ধ সরঞ্জামাদি পরিদর্শন করেন। পাশাপাশি, 'ASEAN Security at the Edge of Emerging Technologies' এই মূল বিষয়কে আলোকপাত করে আয়োজিত 8th Putrajaya Forum এ অংশগ্রহণ করেন। এছাড়া, তিনি মালয়েশিয়ার সংশ্লিষ্ট প্রতিনিধিগনের সাথে সৌজন্য সাক্ষাৎ এবং প্রতিরক্ষা সংক্রান্ত বিষয়, যৌথ উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ, যৌথ প্রশিক্ষণ ও পারস্পরিক সহযোগিতা বিনিময় সংক্রান্ত বিভিন্ন বিষয়ে আলোচনা করেন। উল্লেখ্য, সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান গত ১৯ এপ্রিল ২০২৬ তারিখে সরকারি সফরে মালয়েশিয়া গমন করেন।

राज्यात वाहन तपासणीसाठी एटीएस प्रणाली; स्वयंचलित, पारदर्शक यंत्रणेकडे वाटचाल! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज मुंबई येथे स्वयंचलित वाहन तपासणी केंद्रांसंदर्भात परिवहन विभागाची बैठक संपन्न झाली. राज्यातील वाहनांची फिटनेस तपासणी केवळ नोंदणीकृत स्वयंचलित वाहन तपासणी केंद्राद्वारे (ऑटोमेटेड टेस्टिंग स्टेशन - एटीएस) केली जावी, यासाठी राज्यात 53 स्वयंचलित वाहन तपासणी केंद्रे उभारण्याचे काम प्रगतीपथावर असून ही कामे तत्काळ पूर्ण करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. केंद्रीय मोटार वाहन नियम 62 मध्ये 23 सप्टेंबर 2023 रोजीच्या अधिसूचनेनुसार परिवहन संवर्गातील सर्व वाहनांची फिटनेस चाचणी केवळ नोंदणीकृत स्वयंचलित वाहन तपासणी केंद्रांमार्फत करणे 1 एप्रिल 2025 पासून अनिवार्य करण्यात आले आहे. त्यामुळे आता पारंपरिक मानवी तपासणी पद्धती बाद होणार आहे. याच अनुषंगाने राज्यात 7 केंद्रे पूर्ण झाली असून उर्वरित 37 स्वयंचलित वाहन तपासणी केंद्रे ऑगस्ट अखेर कार्यान्वित होतील व प्रलंबित तपासणी केंद्रांबाबत अन्य विभागाशी समन्वयाने कार्यवाही करून तातडीने ती केंद्रे सुरू करण्याबाबतचे नियोजन करावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्यातील काही स्वयंचलित वाहन तपासणी केंद्रांवर केंद्र शासनाकडून निर्बंध लादण्यात आले होते मात्र मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या मागणीनंतर ती केंद्रे पुनर्संचयित करण्यात आली आहेत. राज्यात सध्या सुमारे 4.33 कोटी वाहने असून, त्यापैकी 36.80 लाख वाहने परिवहन प्रवर्गातील आहेत. यातील सुमारे 9 लाख वाहनांना दरवर्षी फिटनेस चाचणी करणे आवश्यक ठरणार आहे. एटीएस प्रणालीमुळे वाहन तपासणी प्रक्रिया पूर्णपणे स्वयंचलित, संगणकीकृत आणि पारदर्शक होणार असून, मानवी हस्तक्षेप कमी झाल्याने अचूकतेत वाढ होणार असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. महाराष्ट्रात एकूण 53 शासकीय एटीएस केंद्रे उभारण्यात येत असून, देशातील एकूण 214 केंद्रांपैकी सुमारे 25% केंद्रे राज्यात असणार आहेत. या प्रकल्पासाठी 5 वर्षांच्या संचालन व देखभालीसाठी सुमारे ₹1035 कोटींचा खर्च अपेक्षित असून, केंद्र शासनाकडून ₹337.74 कोटींचे अनुदान मिळाले असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. यावेळी मंत्री प्रताप सरनाईक, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @PratapSarnaik @madhurimisal #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai #Parivahan

Mayyun Island: a discreet strategic chokepoint at the heart of major rivalries in the Red Sea Mayyun Island, located at the heart of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, is now emerging as a pivotal node in the strategic rivalries shaping the Red Sea. This volcanic outcrop is drawing increasing attention from regional and international powers due to its capacity to control, or disrupt, one of the world’s most critical maritime trade routes. Since early April, several Western intelligence services have requested satellite imagery acquisitions from Airbus Defence and Space, specifically targeting Mayyun. This renewed interest comes amid heightened tensions between anti-Houthi factions, particularly between the internationally recognized Yemeni government (backed by Riyadh) and forces affiliated with Tareq Saleh, nephew of Ali Abdullah Saleh. Long supported by Abu Dhabi, Tareq Saleh is now attracting Washington’s attention, signaling a possible realignment of external backing. A revealing episode illustrates these frictions: on April 1, military transport aircraft reportedly attempted to land on the island but were prevented from doing so by pro-Saudi forces. While this account was officially denied, OSINT analyses nevertheless confirmed the suspicious passage, the previous evening, of an Ilyushin Il-76 (registration TL-ATD), which circled above Mayyun before heading back toward Africa. The aircraft is operated by Invicta Air Cargo, a Central African company with structural ties to Emirati security networks, notably through Gewan Holding, which is close to Hamdan bin Zayed al-Nahyan, brother of President Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan. Technical connections between the two entities (including the reuse of digital infrastructure and transfers of aviation assets) suggest operational continuity. Notably, a few days after flying over Mayyun, the aircraft traveled from Fujairah to the Israeli Nevatim airbase, pointing to broader, and potentially coordinated, logistical circuits. On the ground, the control dynamics over the island have evolved. Initially, Abu Dhabi had been developing discreet air infrastructure there, progress of which was still visible in commercial satellite imagery in 2025. However, since early 2026, the UAE appears to have withdrawn. This shift is part of a broader reassertion of control by Riyadh over local forces (notably those of the Southern Transitional Council), thereby consolidating its direct influence. Currently, control of Mayyun rests on a combination of Tareq Saleh’s forces and a significant Saudi contingent, particularly deployed around the island’s airstrip. However, the aforementioned aerial incident suggests that coordination between these actors remains imperfect, if not openly strained. Moreover, several local sources indicate a deepening of security cooperation between Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Israel on the island. Narratives disseminated by the Houthis had already, as early as February, pointed to joint projects aimed at transforming Mayyun into a forward strategic platform. The objective appears clear: to establish a foothold capable of containing, or countering, any attempt by the Iran-backed Houthis to blockade the strait, echoing recurring tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Finally, the gradual withdrawal of the UAE from its insular positions in Yemen (notably Socotra and Mayyun) now seems nearly complete. According to several security sources, their last active foothold would be Abd al-Kuri Island in the Indian Ocean, marking a strategic repositioning in response to Saudi Arabia’s growing assertiveness. In sum, Mayyun stands out as a true geostrategic chokepoint, where intra-coalition rivalries, shifting alliances, and power projection dynamics converge. Control over this small island far exceeds its size: it directly shapes the security balance of a maritime corridor that is vital on a global scale.

Unlocking the €90 billion loan from the European Union is a priority for Ukraine. Kyiv expects to receive the first tranche by the end of May or early June, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told reporters. These funds will be allocated, in particular, to strengthening the army, producing domestic weapons, procuring scarce weapons from partners, and providing social support for citizens. Volodymyr Zelenskyy / Володимир Зеленський (@ZelenskyyUa) Today is an important day for our defense and for our relations with the European Union. The European support loan for Ukraine has been unblocked – €90 billion over two years. This package will strengthen our army, make Ukraine more resilient, and enable us to fulfill our social obligations to Ukrainians, as set out in law. It matters that Ukraine is securing this level of financial certainty – after more than four years of full-scale war. We are working to ensure that the first tranche from this support package becomes available as early as May–June. The funds from the European package will be directed, among other priorities, to arms production, the procurement of necessary weapons from partners that we do not yet produce in Ukraine, and the preparation of our energy sector and critical infrastructure for the next winter. During meetings in Cyprus, we will also discuss with partners further sanctions pressure on Russia over this war. The 20th package has been unblocked, and it must be followed by other sanctions steps. And we will continue exploring a new format of cooperation with our partners – Drone Deals – which has already proven effective in the Middle East and the Gulf. We believe that only through joint efforts can we achieve truly significant strength – and Europe deserves that kind of strength. ❓This week, we answer a question about education that you submitted through our Info Finder tool: ➡ #YouAsked: What is the current proportion of male and female school principals in South Africa? 📊 There is no publicly available data on the gender breakdown of all school principals, but researchers have calculated estimates. A 2024 international survey found that in South Africa, 66% of principals were male, and 34% female. This included teachers and principals working across 361 schools that provided lower secondary education (Grades 8 and 9). ❗ A larger study looked at public payroll data from over 380,000 teachers, principals and deputy principals in the public sector between 2012 and 2021. It found that 70% of educators were women, but only 39% of principals were women. This gender gap has changed very little since 2012.

If social media posts of Judge Hamayoun Dilawar are authentic (Tosha Khana Case Judge), this is alarming and raises serious and reasonable doubts on credibility of trial being conducted by him. In my view, propriety demands that he should immediately recuse or disassociate himself from the case. It needs to be noted that Seven Member Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in Malik Qayyum Case (reported in 2001 PLD SC 568) held that bias on part of the judge vitiates judicial proceedings. The court further held that an accused has a right of a fair trial by a judicial minded person, not by someone functioning under an influence or bias as the same paralyses his judicial faculties to conduct fair trial. Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

#DidYouKnow Leh’s Project Tsang-da Urban Mission has transformed sustainable waste management in a remote, high-altitude region. It introduced 100% door-to-door waste collection, source segregation, and a solar-powered waste management system. A 30 tonnes-per-day (TPD) solar-powered plant was set up through the initiative, achieving ~95% waste processing, while converting waste into useful products and generating revenue. This initiative has resulted in improved cleanliness and a significant reduction in open dumping in Leh. This self-sustaining waste management model can be potentially replicated in other regions. These achievements have been documented as Best Practices on the NITI for States (NFS) Knowledge Portal—an initiative under the State Support Mission. Bihar is a land of ancient history, spiritual significance, and enduring cultural traditions. As one of the oldest inhabited regions in India, it holds a profound place in the country’s historical and religious narrative. From the sacred site of Bodh Gaya, where Lord Buddha attained enlightenment, to the ancient ruins of Nalanda University, Bihar reflects a legacy of knowledge and spirituality. Festivals like Chhath Puja further highlight its deep-rooted cultural traditions. The state’s cuisine, including Litti Chokha, Thekua, and Sattu-based dishes, reflects simplicity and regional flavours. Its art forms, such as Madhubani painting, continue to represent its cultural identity. Whether it is exploring historical sites, experiencing spiritual journeys, or engaging with its traditions, Bihar offers a journey that is meaningful and rooted in heritage. Participants, including the NRNA President and former Presidents, provided feedback on the draft Act. They mentioned the importance of aligning with the social, economic and cultural rights enshrined in the Constitution of Nepal while keeping non-resident Nepalis' aspirations in mind. Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal shared his plan to present the draft in the upcoming session of Parliament. He further underscored the need for greater clarity in expressing the Constitution's aspirations- both in terms of their conceptual foundations and practical realisation.

Happy Earth Day 🌎🌿 Earth is truly a beauty to behold, as seen in these stunning images captured through the USGS/NASA Landsat program. We capture these satellite images to create a long, continuous record of Earth’s land surface so we can monitor and understand how the planet is changing over time. Artemis II astronaut, Christina Koch, described her powerful experience of viewing our planet from space and what that meant to her. On Earth Day we are reminded of just how breathtaking the place we call home truly is. Images from the Earth As Art collection: ow.ly/BR2n50YObEb 📷1: The Ganges River forms an extensive delta where it enters the Bay of Bengal. The delta is largely covered with swamp forest known as the Sundarbans, which is home to the Royal Bengal Tiger. 📷2: The Yukon River flows from northern British Columbia through Yukon, Canada, and Alaska, USA, before emptying into the Bering Sea. Discover the geology beneath your feet 🔍🌍 The ground you walk on holds more than just rocks. It holds stories. Geoheritage identifies geologic features that shape our landscapes and our history, culture, and identity as a nation. These places help us understand Earth’s past and how it affects us today. From the columnar basalt formations of Devils Postpile National Monument to dunes shaped by wind and glacial sands at Indiana Dunes National Park, these sites show how geologic processes shape the land and how people study and use it. USGS scientists study and share these places to support research, education, and public understanding. 🎉 This month marks one year since the Geoheritage Sites of the Nation Explorer launched. It’s an honor to have @WHO Director-General @DrTedros and @WHOEURO Regional Director Dr @Hans_Kluge in #Kazakhstan to demonstrate WHO’s commitment to supporting Central Asian nations to address the health impacts of environmental degradation and promote the wellbeing of children.

In Astana, on behalf of WHO/Europe, I accepted from Viorel Gutu of FAO the role of Chair of the Regional Quadripartite mechanism for Europe and Central Asia. The name of this mechanism may sound technical, but its mission is very important. Together, @WHO, @FAO, @WOAH and @UNEP help countries tackle health risks that sit at the intersection of people, animals, plants and the environment — the heart of the #OneHealth approach. The need for this work is hard to ignore: 75% of new and emerging human diseases come from animals, causing 2.7 million deaths each year; over 23 million people fall ill annually from unsafe food; and extreme heat, wildfires and vector-borne diseases are adding new pressure, especially on the most vulnerable. Resources may be tighter, but our purpose is not. Working closely with my fellow regional directors - @ViorelGutu (FAO), @BudimirPlavsic (WOAH) and @KreilhuberA (UNEP) - we will continue supporting Member States with practical tools, evidence-based policymaking, and coordinated action across sectors.

Today I signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Amb Orazbay Askhat, Chairman of the Executive Committee of the International Fund for Saving the Aral Sea (IFAS), to strengthen our cooperation on health, well-being and environmental resilience in the Aral Sea basin. IFAS is a subregional body that brings all 5 Central Asian countries together around water, environment and sustainable development - with growing attention to health. Our discussion was pragmatic and forward-looking. We agreed to focus on concrete, measurable work: linking environment and health more closely, supporting the Aral Sea Roadmap, strengthening technical exchange and capacity, mobilizing resources jointly, and building stronger partnerships for implementation.

Amna Baloch. The Prime Minister conveyed his warm regards and greetings for H.E. President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang. While expressing his satisfaction at the positive trajectory of Pakistan-China bilateral relations, the Prime Minister reaffirmed that Pakistan took great pride in its All-Weather Cooperative Strategic Partnership with China. He also spoke of his resolve to continue working closely with the Chinese leadership, to ensure that the relationship grows from strength to strength. The regional situation in the Middle East and Pakistan’s peace efforts also came under discussion during the meeting. The Chinese Ambassador thanked the Prime Minister for receiving him and expressed China’s appreciation of Pakistan’s diplomatic efforts for lasting peace in the region. He reaffirmed China’s commitment to strengthening its iron-clad ties with Pakistan and to take them to new heights, as envisioned by President Xi Jinping. Video

ریاست هواشناسی وزارت ترانسپورت و هوانوردی طالبان احتمال بارش باران و سرازیرشدن سیلاب‌‌ را در ۲۷ ولایت کشور پیش‌بینی کرده است. براساس پیش‌بینی این ریاست، امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۳ ثور) و فردا ولایت‌های نورستان، کنر، ننگرهار، لغمان، کاپیسا، کابل، پنجشیر، پروان، بغلان، سمنگان، بدخشان، تخار، جوزجان، سرپل، بلخ، فاریاب، غور، بادغیس، هرات، فراه، دایکندی، بامیان، غزنی، میدان وردک، لوگر، خوست و پکتیا شاهد بارندگی خواهند بود. ریاست هواشناسی طالبان میزان بارندگی در نقاط مختلف این ولایت‌ها را بین ۱۰ تا ۳۰ میلی‌متر پیش‌بینی کرده است. این ریاست همچنین احتمال وزش باد با سرعت ۵۰ تا ۹۰ کیلومتر در ساعت را در ولایت‌های مرکزی، شرقی و جنوب‌شرقی پیش‌بینی کرده است.

مسئولان محلی طالبان در سمنگان می‌گویند که مسیر مواصلاتی این ولایت با ولایت بلخ، براثر سرازیرشدن سیلاب‌ به روی ترافیک بسته شده است. حشمت‌الله رحمانی، سخن‌گوی فرماندهی امنیه‌ی طالبان در سمنگان گفته است که این مسیر از صبح امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۳ ثور) بسته شده است. او افزوده است که سرازیرشدن سیلاب‌ باعث شده است که این مسیر در ساحات «فیروزنخچیر» و «تنگی تاشقرغان» به روی ترافیک بسته شود. رحمانی گفته است که تلاش برای بازگشایی این مسیر ادامه دارد.

مسؤولین محلی در ولایت‌های بادغیس و غور می‌گویند که در پی سرازیرشدن سیلاب‌ها در این ولایات، دست‌کم پنج تن به‌شمول یک زن جان باخته و صدها خانهٔ مسکونی تخریب شده‌اند. جزئیات کامل را در لینک زیر بخوانید: shorturl.at/CJnPp #سیلاب #غور #بادغیس #تلفات_و_خسارات #Floods #Ghor #Badghis #CasualtiesAndDamage

LLMs have gotten good enough at reverse engineering to recover source code from obfuscated binaries with real accuracy. So we asked the obvious next question: how fast and cheap is it to use one to build obfuscation specifically designed to beat it? We benchmarked Claude Opus 4.6 against the Tigress obfuscator across 20 targets first, to map its strengths and failure modes. 40% solve rate. Phase 3 multi-layer combos hit 0%, with cost explosions that killed the runs. Then we ran a dev/test/refine loop to build 3 purpose-built obfuscation variants targeting the same crackme, iterating directly against the model's known weaknesses. The finding: LLM-targeted obfuscation is fast and cheap to develop. Context windows, budget caps, and shortcut biases are all exploitable attack surfaces. The arms race just shifted.

اسلام آباد: 23 اپریل 2026 وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے انرجی سیکیورٹی کے حوالے سے اہم اجلاس کی صدارت کی. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ انرجی سیکیورٹی اب ملک کی مستقبل کی مجموعی منصوبہ بندی کا انتہائی اہم حصہ بن چکی ہے. موجودہ علاقائی صورتحال میں توانائی کی بچت اور اس حوالے سے بروقت اٹھائے گئے اقدامات سے توانائی کا بحران پیدا نہیں ہوا. توانائی کی بچت اور پائیدار ترقی کے لیے ذرائع آمد و رفت کو بتدریج ماحول دوست برقی ذرائع (EV) پر منتقل کیا جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایات دیں کہ مستقبل کی توانائی کی ضروریات کے پیش نظر ملک میں خام تیل کے اسٹریٹجک ذخائر رکھنے کے حوالے سے منصوبے پر کام جاری ہے. مستقبل میں سرکاری استعمال کیلئے صرف بجلی سے چلنے والی بسیں اور موٹر سائیکلیں خریدی جائیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے اپنی گفتگو کے دوران مزید کہا کہ ای وی کے لئے چارجنگ سٹیشنز کے قیام کے لئے مزید تیزی سے اقدامات لئے جائیں. شمسی توانائی سے پیدا کردہ اضافی بجلی کی سٹوریج کے لیے بیٹریوں کا حصول آسان بنانے کے لیے لائحہ عمل تشکیل دیا جائے. مقامی طور پر اعلی معیار کی اسٹوریج بیٹریاں تیار کرنے کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جائے. اجلاس کو بریفنگ کے دوران بتایا گیا کہ علاقائی صورتحال کے تناظر میں توانائی کے شعبے کے حوالے سے تشکیل دی گئی نیشنل کوارڈینیشن اینڈ مینجمنٹ کونسل (NCMC) صورتحال کا روزانہ کی بنیادوں پر جائزہ لے رہی ہے. ملک میں اس وقت پیٹرولیم کے وافر ذخائر موجود ہیں. ملک میں غذائی سیکیورٹی کی صورتحال مستحکم ہے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ تیل اور گیس کمپنیوں کی مسلسل کوششوں سے گیس اور تیل کی مقامی پیداوار میں اضافہ ہو رہا ہے. گرڈ کی سطح پر بیٹری اسٹوریج کیلئے 2 تجرباتی منصوبوں کا PC-I تیار کیا جا رہا ہے. شمسی توانائی پیدا کرنے والے گھریلو صارفین کو بیٹری اسٹوریج لگانے کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جارہی ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزرا مصدق مسعود ملک ، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، سردار اویس لغاری، عطاللہ تارڑ، علی پرویز ملک، احسن اقبال، مشیر برائے نجکاری محمد علی، وزیر مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی۔ Video

342 skilled construction workers retire every day in the US. Use interior wall finishing as an example, you can't just hand someone a trowel and get a Level 5 wall finish. It takes years to develop that skill. This is Okibo's fully autonomous interior finishing robot that does drywall mudding, joint taping, sanding (Level 4 and 5 finishes), and spray and roller painting (the video is a sanding pass). It can reach up to 24' so it's designed for high reach in large industrial spaces (data centers, commercial, offsite manufacturing). You just swap the toolhead for a different finish application. It's an autonomous operation, vision scans the path and starts, there’s one operator overseeing the work and changing tool heads when needed. Today, it can produce 6,000 sqft/day (up to 8-10x more productive depending on the space). At the 47th Meeting of the ASEAN Ministers on Agriculture and Forestry, ministers reaffirmed ASEAN’s commitment to strengthening cooperation in food, agriculture, and forestry. The meeting endorsed the ASEAN Vision for Food, Agriculture and Forestry Towards 2045 and adopted the ASEAN Food, Agriculture and Forestry Sectoral Plan 2026–2030. Key priorities include sustainable and regenerative agriculture, climate resilience, food security and nutrition, digital innovation, trade connectivity, and sustainable forest management. Bihar is a land of ancient history, spiritual significance, and enduring cultural traditions. As one of the oldest inhabited regions in India, it holds a profound place in the country’s historical and religious narrative. From the sacred site of Bodh Gaya, where Lord Buddha attained enlightenment, to the ancient ruins of Nalanda University, Bihar reflects a legacy of knowledge and spirituality. Festivals like Chhath Puja further highlight its deep-rooted cultural traditions. The state’s cuisine, including Litti Chokha, Thekua, and Sattu-based dishes, reflects simplicity and regional flavours. Its art forms, such as Madhubani painting, continue to represent its cultural identity. Whether it is exploring historical sites, experiencing spiritual journeys, or engaging with its traditions, Bihar offers a journey that is meaningful and rooted in heritage. Phase 3 multi-layer combos hit 0%, with cost explosions that killed the runs. Then we ran a dev/test/refine loop to build 3 purpose-built obfuscation variants targeting the same crackme, iterating directly against the model's known weaknesses. The finding: LLM-targeted obfuscation is fast and cheap to develop. Context windows, budget caps, and shortcut biases are all exploitable attack surfaces. The arms race just shifted.

CVE-2026-28825, heap OOB in smbfs.kext, reachable by clicking on any smb:// link in Finder, Safari, or Messages. Root cause is a missing bounds check on an attacker-controlled compress length. Cada uma das viagens internacionais que realizamos é uma oportunidade de fazer novas parcerias, reafirmar a posição do Brasil no mundo e buscar mais investimentos para o país. Com esta que finalizamos ontem não foi diferente. Voltamos para casa com acordos de cooperação assinados e novos investimentos para o Brasil. Na Espanha, assinamos acordos em áreas como ciência e tecnologia, minerais críticos, transporte aéreo, empreendedorismo, cultura, igualdade racial e proteção às mulheres. Na Alemanha, firmamos parcerias em setores como defesa, inteligência artificial, tecnologias quânticas, infraestrutura, economia circular, eficiência energética, bioeconomia e pesquisa oceânica e climática. Na Feira de Hannover, que neste ano teve o Brasil como país parceiro, anunciamos investimento de 2 bilhões de euros em projeto de hidrogênio de baixo carbono e derivados, no Rio Grande do Norte. Assinamos declarações para aporte da ordem de R$ 4 bilhões em projetos verdes no Brasil. E apresentamos o biodiesel brasileiro, que foi testado nas estradas alemãs e mostrou maior redução na emissão de gases de efeito estufa, o que mostra o potencial do Brasil para a transição energética. Seguimos trabalhando para que cada conquista lá fora se transforme em mais oportunidades, renda e qualidade de vida para os brasileiros.

In the Yukon Delta, countless lakes, sloughs, and ponds are interconnected across one of the largest river deltas in the world. 📷3: Sediment in the Gulf of Mexico off the Louisiana coast forms layered patterns of color in the water. This week, I closely engaged with @IFAD’s Executive Board during our Annual Informal Meeting and our 147th Executive Board Meeting. These exchanges are always valuable and important opportunities to learn. Our discussions reaffirmed that IFAD’s mandate and comparative advantage are as relevant today as they were at its creation 50 years ago, in response to a global food crisis and economic shocks. That relevance has only increased in today’s geopolitical context. Delivering impact at scale requires coordinated action and investments. This is precisely where IFAD is uniquely positioned as an international financial institution: at the intersection of public and private finance, translating global priorities into investments at the first mile. Building on IFAD’s strong progress in scaling up its private sector engagement, we had a constructive discussion at the Executive Board on how to further refine our strategic direction. A key priority going forward will be to enhance complementarity between our sovereign operations and private sector investments, while increasing our focus on catalytic investments in rural SMEs to drive inclusive and sustainable rural transformation. I was encouraged by the strong sense of alignment and shared responsibility across the Board and IFAD Management. This relationship underpins IFAD’s standing as a model for effective, transparent and accountable governance. Maintaining this close partnership will be key as we navigate increasing complexity and continue to deliver results. #FinancingTheFirstMile

اسلام آباد : 22 اپریل, 2026 وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے انسداد پولیو پر اہم جائزہ اجلاس کی صدارت کی. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ملک سے پولیو کے موزی مرض کے مکمل خاتمے کے لئے پرعزم ہیں. وزیراعظم نے پولیو کے خلاف جنگ میں انسداد پولیو ٹیم کی بھرپور کوششوں کی تعریف کی. اجلاس کو ملک میں جاری انسداد پولیو اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ سال 2026 میں اب تک پاکستان میں پولیو کا صرف ایک کیس ، ضلع سجاول سے رپورٹ ہوا ہے. 2024 میں پولیو کے 74 کیسز اور 2025 میں 31 کیسز رپورٹ ہوئے. صوبہء پنجاب، خیبر پختونخوا ، بلوچستان ، اسلام آباد ، گلگت بلتستان اور آزاد جموں و کشمیر سے اس سال اب تک پولیو کا کوئی کیس سامنے نہیں آیا. سال 2025 کی پہلی سہ ماہی میں ملک کے 67 اضلاع پولیو سے متاثرہ تھے جن کی تعداد سال 2026 کی پہلی سہ ماہی میں کم ہو کر 23 رہ گئی. نیشنل ہاؤس ہولڈ کوریج تمام انسداد پولیو مہمات میں 98 فیصد رہی. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ خیبر پختونخوا کے جنوبی اضلاع میں بہتر رسائی اور انسداد پولیو مہم کی وجہ سے پولیو قطروں سے محروم رہ جانے والے بچوں کی تعداد میں کمی آئی ہے. کوئٹہ بلاک میں پولیو وائرس کی مقامی پھیلاؤ میں بڑی کمی دیکھنے میں آئی ہے. کراچی میں مارچ کے مہینے میں 12 میں سے 10 ماحولیاتی نمونوں میں پولیو وائرس نہیں پایا گیا جو کہ ایک اچھی پیشرفت ہے. ضلع ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں ستمبر 2025 سے پولیو کا کوئی کیس رپورٹ نہیں ہوا. ضلع بنوں میں پولیو سے زیادہ متاثرہ یونین کونسلوں کی تعداد 62 سے کم ہو کر 6 رہ گئی. اجلاس کو بریفنگ دی گئی کہ وفاق اور صوبائی سطحوں پر ای پی آئی اور پی ای آئی کے انضمام کے حوالے سے حکمت عملی ترتیب دی جا رہی ہے. بے نظیر انکم سپورٹ پروگرام کے اقدامات کو انسداد پولیو سے جوڑنے اور مشروط کرنے کے حوالے سے بھی کام کیا جا رہا ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزیر اطلاعات و نشریات عطاء اللہ تارڑ ، وفاقی وزیر قومی صحت مصطفیٰ کمال ، وزیر مملکت برائے قومی صحت ڈاکٹر ملک مختار احمد بھرتھ، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ و ریلوے بلال اظہر کیانی ،وزیراعظم کی فوکل پرسن برائے انسداد پولیو سینیٹر عائشہ رضا فاروق اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی ۔ Video

The Heterodox Academy Study understates the role that DEI continues to play at US universities. Few universities have laid off their DEI specialists. On the contrary, they have converted their DEI offices, often without major staffing changes, to offices with neutral-sounding names designed to circumvent state bans and avoid federal scrutiny. A few examples of sanitized names: 1. Office for Community and Connections (University of Maine) 2. Division of Access and Opportunity (University of Oklahoma), 3. Office of Equal Opportunity Compliance and Engagement (Florida State University), 4. Office for Resilience and Belonging (University of Tulsa) 5. Open Doors, Open Hearts, and Open Minds (Cornell University) 6. Office for Campus Enrichment and Engagement (Case Western Reserve University). Whatever one thinks of DEI’s usefulness, this is a remarkable display of linguistic creativity. The Missing Data Depot (@data_depot) New @HdxAcademy study finds the % of faculty job ads requesting applicants to address DEI in their applications dropped by more than half, from 25.4% in 2024 to 11.0% in 2025. We held a meeting on strategic issues of Ukraine’s policy of remembrance and honoring national heroes. In particular, work has begun on creating a Pantheon of Prominent Ukrainians. The scope of the relevant tasks is extremely broad and requires the involvement of various state institutions, Ukrainian society, and diplomatic engagement with many of Ukraine’s partners. This is primarily about bringing historical figures back to Ukraine – those who are of fundamental importance for shaping Ukrainian national consciousness and for our state-building. It is also about Heroes’ Policy in Ukraine, proper memorialization of different stages of our history, and the full restoration of all of Ukraine’s historical memory. We must create a special space of value-based consolidation for the Ukrainian people, one that will truly matter for future generations and preserve the memory of the generations who built our culture and our state. I thank the Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine, Ruslan Stefanchuk, the Head of the Office of the President, Kyrylo Budanov, Deputy Head of the Office Iryna Vereshchuk, and the entire team already involved for their substantive work in fulfilling this task. We have defined our next steps. Thank you to everyone who will contribute to this effort! Glory to Ukraine!

पाक क्रिकेटर मोहम्मद नवाज का ड्रग टेस्ट पॉजिटिव पाकिस्तान के स्टार ऑलराउंडर मोहम्मद नवाज इस समय पाकिस्तान क्रिकेट बोर्ड (PCB) की गंभीर जांच के दायरे में हैं. नवाज कथित तौर पर 'रिक्रिएशनल ड्रग' (नशीली दवा) के सेवन के लिए पॉजिटिव पाए गए हैं. इस घटना ने नवाज की इंग्लैंड में सरे टीम के लिए टी20 ब्लास्ट खेलने की योजनाओं को पूरी तरह से पटरी से उतार दिया है और उनके साथ हुआ करार अब आधिकारिक तौर पर रद्द कर दिया गया है. रिपोर्टों के अनुसार,पूर्व कप्तान बाबर आजम के चहेते खिलाड़ी नवाज का यह पॉजिटिव टेस्ट इस साल की शुरुआत में श्रीलंका में आयोजित टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 के दौरान लिए गए नमूनों से सामने आया है. 32 वर्षीय इस खिलाड़ी ने टूर्नामेंट के सभी सात मैचों में शिरकत की थी, जहां उन्होंने कुल 15 रन बनाए और सात विकेट झटके थे. आईसीसी (ICC) ने इस जांच के परिणाम के बारे में पीसीबी को सूचित किया, जिसके बाद बोर्ड ने तुरंत अपनी अनुशासनात्मक प्रक्रिया शुरू कर दी है. नवाज ने मई से जुलाई के बीच होने वाले टी20 ब्लास्ट के लिए सरे के साथ समझौता किया था और पीसीबी ने उन्हें महज दो सप्ताह पहले ही अनापत्ति प्रमाण पत्र (NOC) भी दे दिया था. हालांकि, इस जांच के शुरू होते ही सरे ने अपने हाथ पीछे खींच लिए हैं और समझौता समाप्त कर दिया है. सरे ने फिलहाल इस पर कोई आधिकारिक टिप्पणी नहीं की है और न ही किसी वैकल्पिक खिलाड़ी के नाम की घोषणा की है. #MohammadNawaz #Drugs #DrugsTest #PCB #PakistanCricket #PakistanNews #T20WorldCup

I am grateful to: ▶️Kazakhstan and Minister Akmaral Alnazarova for their support in organizing this important event ▶️ @DrTedros for joining us and lending his support ▶️ Prime Minister @katrinjak, Chair of the Pan-European Commission on Climate and Health, for bringing a strong political voice to the discussion ▶️ my Special Representative on Climate and Health, Robb Butler, our Office in Bonn, and our Country Office in Kazakhstan, led by @Syla_Skenda, for the dedication and hard work on and behind the scenes that made today’s event possible. 3/3

Today’s event was not just about discussion. It was about decisions. I signed 4 important documents with: ▶️the ministries of health of Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, to strengthen cooperation for a healthier future in the Aral Sea region ▶️ the Akimat of Atyrau Region and the 🇰🇿Ministry of Health, to advance joint research on the links between environment and health ▶️ the Akimat of Kyzylorda Region and the 🇰🇿Ministry of Health, to help shape an Aral Sea environment and health programme ▶️ the health ministers of the Central Asian countries and Azerbaijan, to build shared regional commitment for action in both the Aral Sea region and the Caspian basin I am confident these agreements will not remain on paper. 2/3

In Astana, we had a truly important event, the results of which will be felt for years to come. As part of the Regional Ecological Summit, we held a high-level session with the health ministers of Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan on how to address the health consequences of the Aral Sea crisis, and how its lessons can guide action for health in the Caspian basin. Three things stood out to me during today’s discussions: 1⃣ political will – countries recognize the impact of climate change on health and are ready to act 2⃣ commitment to sustainable financing - because without resources, progress will not happen 3⃣ trust in science – countries want to move forward with evidence-based action 1/3

त्र्यंबकेश्वर सिंहस्थ कुंभमेळा 2027 साठी टप्पा 2 मधील ₹1063 कोटींच्या कामांच्या प्रस्तावाला मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी मंजुरी दिली. मुंबई मेट्रो मार्गिका 5अ, टप्पा 1 आणि टप्पा 2 या मार्गिकेची लांबी 34.21 किमी आहे, ज्यामध्ये 19 स्थानकांचा समावेश आहे. टप्पा 1 कापूरबावडी ते धामणकर नाका, टप्पा 2 धामणकर नाका ते दुर्गाडी, मार्गिका 5-अ दुर्गाडी - कल्याण – उल्हासनगर या प्रकल्पामुळे ठाणे, भिवंडी, कल्याण आणि उल्हासनगर या भागातील सुमारे 69,00,000 लोकांना फायदा होणार असून प्रवासाचा वेळ 40-50% कमी होईल. या प्रकल्पासाठीच्या आवश्यक परवानगीसाठी केंद्र शासन व संबंधित विभागाकडे गतीने कार्यवाही करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांंनी दिले. महाराष्ट्र राज्य रस्ते विकास महामंडळाने नागपूर-गोंदिया, भंडारा-गडचिरोली आणि नागपूर-चंद्रपूर या 3 द्रुतगती महामार्ग प्रकल्पांचे 'प्रकल्प कार्यान्वित करण्याचे वेळापत्रक' निश्चित करण्याच्या सूचना तसेच निविदा प्रसिद्धी, निविदा अंतिम करणे आणि प्रकल्प पूर्णतेचा कालावधी निश्चित करावा. या प्रकल्पांसाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या भूसंपादनाकरिता हुडकोकडून कर्ज उभारण्याच्या प्रस्तावावर वित्त विभागाशी समन्वय साधून तातडीने मार्ग काढावा. विदर्भातील दळणवळण आणि उद्योगांना चालना देण्यासाठी हे प्रकल्प अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे असल्याने 6 वर्षांत हे प्रकल्प पूर्ण होण्यासाठी कार्यवाही करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. नागपूर-गोंदिया द्रुतगती महामार्गाची एकूण लांबी 162.577 किमी असून, प्रकल्पाची एकूण अंदाजित किंमत ₹19,582.19 कोटी आहे. या प्रकल्पाच्या भूसंपादनासाठी ₹3162.18 कोटींच्या खर्चास, भंडारा-गडचिरोली द्रुतगती महामार्ग 94.241 किमी लांबीच्या या प्रकल्पाच्या भूसंपादनासाठी ₹931.15 कोटी, तर 204.799 किमी लांबीच्या नागपूर-चंद्रपूर द्रुतगती महामार्ग प्रकल्पाच्या भूसंपादनासाठी ₹2353.94 कोटींच्या प्रशासकीय खर्चाला मंजुरी देण्यात आली. नाशिक सिंहस्थ कुंभमेळ्यासाठी येणाऱ्या भाविकांना उत्तम सोयी-सुविधा मिळण्यासाठी प्रस्तावित पायाभूत सुविधांची कामे तसेच भाविकांसाठी वाहनतळ, पाणीपुरवठा, विद्युतविभाग, आरोग्य विभाग, घनकचरा व्यवस्थापन, मुख्य नियंत्रण कक्ष यासाठी ₹1063 कोटींच्या कामांच्या प्रस्तावाला मंजूरी देण्यात आली असून ही कामे गतीने पूर्ण निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, मंत्री चंद्रशेखर बावनकुळे, मंत्री शिवेंद्रसिंह राजे भोसले, मंत्री उदय सामंत आणि वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @cbawankule @Shivendraraje11 @samant_uday #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai

The CNO and @SECNAV held press interviews at Sea Air Space this week. Old Pentagon Press Corps: Invited. New Pentagon Press Corps: Not invited. One more way the Pentagon bureaucracy slow-rolls Trump’s agenda while keeping liberal legacy media on the guest list. I know what I’ll hear back: I didn’t file through the right CHINFO desk, didn’t route through the proper channel, didn’t check the right box. Exactly. That’s how the filter works. It rewards institutional memory and punishes anyone without a full-time compliance officer to work the paperwork. Or the CNO’s top PAO will say, “I gave you my card months ago.” He did. The problem is that when you’re invited to the last conference, you assume you’ll be invited to the next one. Not a crazy assumption. Fine, I should have reached out. But what’s the incentive when last time I got one question with zero follow-up? Is it even worth going to official press events anymore? gCaptain doesn’t have two decades of Pentagon rolodex. We don’t have interns to navigate the form maze. We don’t have a NYTimes-scale legal team to sue the Department of War when the doors close on us. We have readers. The largest maritime audience in the world. Millions glued to our coverage of Hormuz. We’re too busy reporting the actual news. This isn’t the first time I’ve been frozen out. The difference is that in previous years there were open mics for Q&A. Anyone could walk up and ask one question. Now you get zero questions. Nada. Zip. Unless you know every backchannel and sub-organization inside the Pentagon that can schedule you in. Or you have a liberal federal judge willing to hear your case. This is the most transparent administration in my lifetime. I had a long conversation with the maritime director at the White House and the Merchant Marine Commandant, among others. I had plenty of conversations with O-6s and below throughout the conference. It’s just the Service Secretaries and senior Admirals and Generals who are working in the shadows. And the saddest part: the squeaky wheels get the grease. The reporters who live in DC. The ones who know how to jump through the hoops and make a scene. The system self-selects for “journalists” proven to be pedantic and irritable. This isn’t a complaint, it’s an observation. IFGAF about special access in smoke-filled rooms. I’d rather spend my time with a Lieutenant Commander just off a plane from Bahrain than any four star. I was one of the only journalists who praised Hegseth for closing down my office and banning all media, including newly selected independents like myself, from the Pentagon. If the CNO and SECNAV want to hold zero press events, that’s their prerogative. The problem is taxpayers are spending millions on PAO salaries and systems that overwhelmingly favor MSM. And the problem is this is all happening in DC. Great stories don’t live in DC. They live closer to the front lines. @PeteHegseth has gone out of his way to invite small pro-American media on his flights, trips, and press conferences. He has lead by example. Those under him have mostly not. Several high-level sources have told me Hegseth wants the new Pentagon press out at bases, in the field, and aboard ships. Not just reporting from DC. The sum total of trips aboard ships at sea I’ve received since getting my pass: zero. Every military college teaches commander’s intent. Hegseth’s intent is clearly to bring a mix of media along. The Senior Admirals and the Secretaries of the Army and Navy have made their intent clear too: avoid us. And because they refuse, it’s nearly impossible to report the extraordinary job our sailors, soldiers, and airmen are doing in the Middle East. This is a big part of why ridiculous threads from European journalists about Iran winning the war go viral, while the independent reporting coming off our Navy ships does not.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ Shut down the PAO system and refund the cash or make the system fair. That’s all I ask.

STATEMENT: Following the Afghanistan Withdrawal Special Review Panel’s recommendation and at the direction of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, the United States Marine Corps has upgraded the valor awards for the Marines of Company G, 2d Battalion, 1st Marines, who stood at Abbey Gate on 26 August 2021. After reviewing the original awards and determining that several had been inappropriately downgraded, these awards have now been upgraded to levels that more accurately reflect the extreme risk these Marines knowingly accepted and the lives they saved under direct enemy fire. The Marines at Abbey Gate were positioned in the direct blast zone with minimal cover, fully aware of an imminent suicide attack, yet they held their ground to keep evacuation operations running. Their actions that day were heroic. The original awards did not reflect that reality. Today’s upgrades correct that injustice. This outcome would not have happened without the personal leadership and commitment of Under Secretary of War for Personnel & Readiness Anthony Tata and Senior Advisor Stu Scheller who worked tirelessly behind the scenes to ensure these Marines receive the recognition they deserve. Mr. Scheller personally shepherded this effort, driving the process forward until justice was done. This outcome also demonstrates what the Afghanistan Withdrawal Special Review Panel was created to do: examine the full record, identify where the system failed our warfighters, and ensure accountability and fairness. The Department of War, under President Trump and Secretary Hegseth, is committed to getting this right. We will not allow valor performed at the point of friction to be diminished by bureaucratic or administrative shortcomings. To the Marines of Company G and to every service member who stood at Abbey Gate: your actions were seen, your sacrifice was measured correctly, and your valor is now properly recognized. The Panel will continue its broader work to ensure the lessons from 2021 are learned and that we never again place our warfighters in positions where their courage is not fully honored. We owe the American people, the families of the fallen, and every service member who served in Afghanistan nothing less than the truth and the corrections that truth demands.

The $30 billion figure likely derives from Russia’s genuinely alarming fiscal performance in January and February, when front-loaded military spending collided with weak oil revenues to produce a deficit of 3.5 trillion roubles (£34.6 billion) – uncomfortably close to the entire planned annual shortfall of 3.8 trillion roubles (£37.5 billion). The Kremlin was rattled; a revenue review was mooted; spending cuts were discussed. Then the US and Israel attacked Iran. Russian Urals crude oil, which had been trading at $44.6 (£33) a barrel, is now above $100 (£74). Every additional $10 (£7.40) per barrel adds roughly $1.6 billion (£1.2 billion) a month to federal revenues. Analysts expect oil to average at around $90 (£66.60) per barrel this year; the Russian budget was built on $59 (£44). At that price, the arithmetic runs heavily in Moscow’s favour. اسلام آباد : 22 اپریل, 2026 وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے انسداد پولیو پر اہم جائزہ اجلاس کی صدارت کی. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ملک سے پولیو کے موزی مرض کے مکمل خاتمے کے لئے پرعزم ہیں. وزیراعظم نے پولیو کے خلاف جنگ میں انسداد پولیو ٹیم کی بھرپور کوششوں کی تعریف کی. اجلاس کو ملک میں جاری انسداد پولیو اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ سال 2026 میں اب تک پاکستان میں پولیو کا صرف ایک کیس ، ضلع سجاول سے رپورٹ ہوا ہے. 2024 میں پولیو کے 74 کیسز اور 2025 میں 31 کیسز رپورٹ ہوئے. صوبہء پنجاب، خیبر پختونخوا ، بلوچستان ، اسلام آباد ، گلگت بلتستان اور آزاد جموں و کشمیر سے اس سال اب تک پولیو کا کوئی کیس سامنے نہیں آیا. سال 2025 کی پہلی سہ ماہی میں ملک کے 67 اضلاع پولیو سے متاثرہ تھے جن کی تعداد سال 2026 کی پہلی سہ ماہی میں کم ہو کر 23 رہ گئی. نیشنل ہاؤس ہولڈ کوریج تمام انسداد پولیو مہمات میں 98 فیصد رہی. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ خیبر پختونخوا کے جنوبی اضلاع میں بہتر رسائی اور انسداد پولیو مہم کی وجہ سے پولیو قطروں سے محروم رہ جانے والے بچوں کی تعداد میں کمی آئی ہے. کوئٹہ بلاک میں پولیو وائرس کی مقامی پھیلاؤ میں بڑی کمی دیکھنے میں آئی ہے. کراچی میں مارچ کے مہینے میں 12 میں سے 10 ماحولیاتی نمونوں میں پولیو وائرس نہیں پایا گیا جو کہ ایک اچھی پیشرفت ہے. ضلع ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں ستمبر 2025 سے پولیو کا کوئی کیس رپورٹ نہیں ہوا. ضلع بنوں میں پولیو سے زیادہ متاثرہ یونین کونسلوں کی تعداد 62 سے کم ہو کر 6 رہ گئی. اجلاس کو بریفنگ دی گئی کہ وفاق اور صوبائی سطحوں پر ای پی آئی اور پی ای آئی کے انضمام کے حوالے سے حکمت عملی ترتیب دی جا رہی ہے. بے نظیر انکم سپورٹ پروگرام کے اقدامات کو انسداد پولیو سے جوڑنے اور مشروط کرنے کے حوالے سے بھی کام کیا جا رہا ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزیر اطلاعات و نشریات عطاء اللہ تارڑ ، وفاقی وزیر قومی صحت مصطفیٰ کمال ، وزیر مملکت برائے قومی صحت ڈاکٹر ملک مختار احمد بھرتھ، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ و ریلوے بلال اظہر کیانی ،وزیراعظم کی فوکل پرسن برائے انسداد پولیو سینیٹر عائشہ رضا فاروق اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی ۔ Video

جلیل عباس جیلانی، سابق وزیرخارجہ پاکستان کی بہترین ڈپلومیسی کی وجہ سے آج ایران اور امریکا کے درمیان سیز فائر ہے، پھر پاکستان نے 21 گھنٹے مذاکرات کرائے،، مذاکرات سے اسلام آباد ایم او یو نکلا جس پر مذید گفتگو ہونی تھی۔۔ اب آبنائے ہرمز، نیوکلیئر، میزائل، پابندیوں سمیت کئی معاملات میز پر ہیں۔ پاکستان کوشش کر رہا ہے۔ امریکا چاہتا ہے کہ جنگ کا خاتمہ ہو۔ یہ ڈیڈ اینڈ نہیں ہے۔ میرے خیال میں ایران بھی چاہتا ہے کہ معاملات اب درست سمت میں جائیں۔ صدر ٹرمپ کی امریکا میں مقبولیت گری ہے، امریکا کے دوست ممالک، نیٹو، یورپی یونین بھی اس جنگ میں ان کے ساتھ نہیں۔ امریکا کو احساس ہوا ہو گا کہ وہ بے مقصد جنگ کا حصہ بن گئے ہیں۔ #FaislaAapKa TEAM | Hum News @JalilJilani Video

एल निनोच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर पाणी व्यवस्थापनावर भर राज्यातील विविध धरणांमध्ये सुमारे 653.63 टीएमसी पाणीसाठा उपलब्ध असल्याची माहिती आज झालेल्या राज्य मंत्रिमंडळाच्या बैठकीत देण्यात आली. गतवर्षीच्या तुलनेत यंदा 101.77 टीएमसी पाणीसाठा अधिकचा आहे. गतवर्षी हा साठा 551.86 टीएमसी होता. मात्र यंदा एल निनोच्या प्रभावामुळे पाऊसाच्या अनियमतेतमुळे पुढील वर्षी टंचाईचा मुकाबला करता यावा, यासाठी पाणी जपून वापरा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. एल-निनोच्या प्रभावामुळे पाणीसाठ्यात 2014 मध्ये 12% तर 2015 मध्ये सुमारे 14% घट झाली होती. त्यामुळे दोन्ही वर्षी पाणीटंचाई निर्माण झाली होती. 15 ऑक्टोबर 2014 रोजी 872 टीएमसी तर याच दिवशी 2015 ला 625 टीएमसी पाणीसाठा होता. त्या तुलनेत 2025 मध्ये 15 ऑक्टोबरला 1330.97 टीएमसी पाणीसाठा होता. हा पाणीसाठा 21 एप्रिल 2026 रोजी 653.63 टीएमसी आहे. गतवर्षीच्या तुलनेत यंदा सुमारे 101.77 टीएमसी पाणीसाठा अधिकचा आहे. यावर राज्यातील पाणीसाठ्याचे काटेकोर नियोजन करून ऑगस्ट 2026 अखेर पिण्यासाठी पाणी उपलब्ध राहण्याच्या दृष्टीने काटकसरीच्या उपाययोजनांची अंमलबजावणी करावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी एल-निनोच्या प्रभावामुळे या वर्षी पाऊस कमी होण्याची शक्यता असल्याने पुढील वर्षी पुरेसे पाणी उपलब्ध व्हावे या दृष्टीने आतापासून पाण्याचा जपून वापर करण्याचे निर्देश दिले. महसूल विभागनिहाय पाणीसाठा (धरण संख्या) यंदाचा उपयुक्त पाणीसाठा, गतवर्षीचा पाणीसाठा (टीएमसीमध्ये) नागपूर : (387) 80.79, 63.40 अमरावती : (276) 73.72, 65.13 छत्रपती संभाजीनगर : (929) 129.37, 97.09 नाशिक : (539) 101.96, 89.28 पुणे : (724) 206.55, 174.04 कोकण : (173) 61.24, 62.92 एकूण : (3028) 653.63, 551.86 राज्यातील प्रमुख धरणांतील पाणीसाठा : यंदाचा उपयुक्त पाणीसाठा, गतवर्षीचा पाणीसाठा (टिएमसीमध्ये) या क्रमाने - दिल्ली के समस्त किसान साथियों की ओर से माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी का हृदय से आभार। दिल्ली के किसानों के लिए यह बहुत बड़ी राहत और खुशी की खबर है कि अब उनकी गेहूं फसल की खरीद फिर से MSP पर FCI द्वारा की जाएगी। इससे किसान साथियों को अपनी मेहनत की फसल का सही दाम मिलेगा, समय बचेगा और आने-जाने का खर्च भी कम होगा। स्थानीय स्तर पर खरीद शुरू होने से किसानों को अपनी फसल बेचने में आसानी होगी। साथ ही, पीडीएस व्यवस्था मजबूत होगी और खाद्यान्न आपूर्ति भी बेहतर बनेगी। वर्ष 2021-22 से गेहूं खरीद बंद होने के कारण किसानों को परेशानी हो रही थी। इस विषय को प्राथमिकता देते हुए हमने केंद्रीय उपभोक्ता मामले, खाद्य और सार्वजनिक वितरण मंत्री श्री @JoshiPralhad जी को पत्र लिखकर किसानों की समस्या बताई। हमें खुशी है कि केंद्र सरकार ने तुरंत सकारात्मक निर्णय लिया। 24 अप्रैल 2026 से दिल्ली में नरेला स्थित FCI डिपो और नजफगढ़ मंडी में खरीद केंद्र शुरू किए जाएंगे, जिससे किसानों को अपने पास ही फसल बेचने की सुविधा मिलेगी। यह निर्णय किसान सम्मान, किसान समृद्धि और माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी के किसान कल्याण संकल्प का मजबूत उदाहरण है।

“This isn't just about passing a test; it's a direct measure of our commitment to readiness and ensuring our warfighters can dominate in any environment,” said Sgt. Maj. of the Army Michael Weimer. “We're asking more of our combat arms Soldiers, and this test validates their ability to meet that high standard."

The CFT is a continuous sequence of seven events, performed in the Army Combat Uniform, combat boots and a brown T-shirt, with no cover. The entire test is timed as a single event. Events in order are: * A one-mile run * 30 dead-stop push-ups * A 100-meter sprint * 16 lifts of a 40-pound sandbag onto a 65-inch platform * A 50-meter carry of two five-gallon Army water cans weighing 40 pounds each * A 50-meter movement drill consisting of a 25-meter high crawl and a 25-meter 3-5 second rush * A final one-mile run

"The Combat Field Test is a critical step forward in ensuring our Soldiers serving in the most physically demanding specialties have the specific fitness required to dominate on the modern battlefield," said the Secretary of the Army Hon. Dan Driscoll. "This is about readiness, lethality, and the well-being of our Soldiers.”

दिल्ली के समस्त किसान साथियों की ओर से माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी का हृदय से आभार। दिल्ली के किसानों के लिए यह बहुत बड़ी राहत और खुशी की खबर है कि अब उनकी गेहूं फसल की खरीद फिर से MSP पर FCI द्वारा की जाएगी। इससे किसान साथियों को अपनी मेहनत की फसल का सही दाम मिलेगा, समय बचेगा और आने-जाने का खर्च भी कम होगा। स्थानीय स्तर पर खरीद शुरू होने से किसानों को अपनी फसल बेचने में आसानी होगी। साथ ही, पीडीएस व्यवस्था मजबूत होगी और खाद्यान्न आपूर्ति भी बेहतर बनेगी। वर्ष 2021-22 से गेहूं खरीद बंद होने के कारण किसानों को परेशानी हो रही थी। इस विषय को प्राथमिकता देते हुए हमने केंद्रीय उपभोक्ता मामले, खाद्य और सार्वजनिक वितरण मंत्री श्री @JoshiPralhad जी को पत्र लिखकर किसानों की समस्या बताई। हमें खुशी है कि केंद्र सरकार ने तुरंत सकारात्मक निर्णय लिया। 24 अप्रैल 2026 से दिल्ली में नरेला स्थित FCI डिपो और नजफगढ़ मंडी में खरीद केंद्र शुरू किए जाएंगे, जिससे किसानों को अपने पास ही फसल बेचने की सुविधा मिलेगी। यह निर्णय किसान सम्मान, किसान समृद्धि और माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी के किसान कल्याण संकल्प का मजबूत उदाहरण है।

Two things to watch on Capitol Hill today. We could have a vote related to possibly expelling Rep. Cory Mills (R-FL). And the Senate is now into budget reconciliation, trying to fund DHS. The House could vote as early as today on a resolution from Rep. Nancy Mace (R-SC) to expel Mills. He’s accused of campaign finance irregularities and domestic violence. He has not been charged and says he won’t resign. However, the House Ethics Committee investigation into Mills is not complete. That’s why some Members could vote to table or kill any effort to expel Mills. Expulsion takes a two-thirds vote. Some Republicans believe Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-MN) should be the next to go. She faces scrutiny for accumulating wealth during her time in office. Meantime, the Senate is now debating a reconciliation package to fund DHS. The Senate is looking at a round the clock “vote-a-rama” tonight or tomorrow as Republicans try to lock out Democrats and pass the DHS funding measure on their own. That said, there is disagreement between Republicans as to what else should be in the reconciliation bill. Some conservatives want to add the SAVE America Act. There is also a push for Iran war funding, agriculture aid and FEMA assistance. It’s just a question as to how svelte or chunky they want to make the bill. Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) and the White House prefer limiting the bill to DHS-related money.

Our Fairwater datacenter in Wisconsin is going live, ahead of schedule. As the world’s most powerful AI datacenter, it will bring together hundreds of thousands of GB200s into a single seamless cluster. Congrats to all the teams who made this possible! Satya Nadella (@satyanadella) If intelligence is the log of compute… it starts with a lot of compute! And that’s why we’re scaling our GPU fleet faster than anyone else. Just last year, we added over 2 gigawatts of new capacity – roughly the output of 2 nuclear power plants. And today we’re going further, announcing the world's most powerful AI datacenter, located in southeastern Wisconsin. Fairwater is a seamless cluster of hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA GB200s, connected by enough fiber to circle the Earth 4.5 times. It will deliver 10x the performance of the world’s fastest supercomputer today, enabling AI training and inference workloads at a level never before seen. For AI training workloads, you need compute at exponential scale. That’s why we designed the datacenter, GPU fleet, and network together as one integrated system. This ensures a single job can run from day 1 at exponential scale across thousands of GPUs. Fairwater uses a liquid-cooled closed-loop system for cooling GPUs that requires zero water for operations after construction. And we’re matching all of the energy that is consumed with renewable sources. And of course, it is just one of several similar sites we’re lighting up across our 70+ regions. We have multiple identical Fairwater datacenters under construction in other locations across the US, in addition to our AI infrastructure already deployed in over 100 datacenters around the world, powering model training, test-time compute, RL tuning, and real-time inference at global scale. Too often during times like this, people go with the current and only later wonder, how did we get here? With Fairwater, we're charting a new path: doing the hard engineering work, bringing compute, network, and storage into one highly scaled cluster, and designing closed-loop energy systems to meet real-world computing needs. And partnering with local communities to ensure it's thoughtfully done in a way that is sustainable, creates new jobs, and expands opportunity. We are thrilled to see this take hold in Wisconsin, and we are just getting started. Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/satyanadella/status/1968677244861379012#m

اسلام آباد : 22 اپریل, 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت ملک میں بجلی سے چلنے والی گاڑیوں کے فروغ پر جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ملک میں الیکٹرک وہیکلز (EV) کے فروغ میں تیزی لانے کیلئے جاری اقدامات میں تیزی لائی جائے. موجودہ علاقائی صورتحال اور مستقبل کی ضروریات کے پیش نظر ، EV گاڑیوں کے فروغ سے ناصرف ایندھن کے درآمدی بوجھ میں کمی آئے گی، بلکہ یہ ماحولیاتی تحفظ اور انرجی سیکیورٹی کے لیے بھی انتہائی اہم ہے. قومی ای -وی پالیسی کے تحت کم آمدنی والے افراد کیلئے الیکٹرک موٹر سائیکلوں پر دی جانے والی سبسڈی میں شفافیت یقینی بنائی جائے اور اس اسکیم کے نفاذ میں مزید تیزی لائی جائے. اجلاس کو EV کی ملک گیر سطح پر ترویج کیلئے جاری اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ ملک بھر میں الیکٹرک موٹر سائیکل اور رکشہ بنانے کیلئے 72 جبکہ الیکٹرک گاڑیوں کے لیے 4 مینوفیکچرنگ سرٹیفیکیٹ جاری ہو چکے. ای وی چارجنگ اسٹیشنز کے قیام کیلئے اب تک 123 درخواستیں موصول ہوئی ہیں. آئندہ 5 سالوں میں ملک میں 30 فیصد گاڑیاں بجلی سے چلنے کی منصوبہ بندی کی جارہی ہے ہے، جس سے اندازا" 4.5 بلین ڈالر تک فیول کی بچت ہوگی. گریڈ 16 تک کے سرکاری ملازمین کو آسان قسطوں پر الیکٹرک بائیکس فراہم کئے جائیں گے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، عطاللہ تارڑ ، اویس خان لغاری ، احسن اقبال، وزیرِ مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، وزیراعظم کے معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر ، چئیر مین وزیر اعظم یوتھ پروگرام رانا مشہود احمد خان ، گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل احمد اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی.
